{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Filter out non-positive (≤ 0) baseline biomarker values for the 'severe' group
severe_valid_mask = (trial_df['severity'] == 'severe') & (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] > 0)
num_valid_severe = severe_valid_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of valid "severe" patients with biomarker_baseline > 0: {num_valid_severe}')

# Extract valid baseline biomarker values
valid_baseline = trial_df.loc[severe_valid_mask, 'biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean of valid values
mean_valid_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value among valid "severe" patients: {mean_valid_baseline}')"}
